## What needs to happen

Explain the outcome in everyday language. Start with what someone will be able to do or see when this is finished.

## Why it matters

Explain the user or business reason in one short paragraph.

## Done when

- Write observable outcomes, not implementation activity.
- Include how we will know the result works.

## Safety and boundaries

State what must not happen: for example, no live data, no charge, no secrets, or no customer-facing change yet.

## Notes for the builder

Put technical names, links, commands, or implementation details here only when they help complete the task. Explain unfamiliar terms.
